ResearchProjectDef.label: Investiture
ResearchProjectDef.description: The fabric of the Cosmere is shaped by unseen forces—mysterious energies scholars call Investiture. Through careful study of ancient texts and firsthand experimentation, your colonists begin to grasp the fundamental principles of this power. Unlocking Investiture opens the path to understanding Shards, magic systems, and the subtle threads connecting all life to the Spiritual Realm. This is the first step toward wielding powers once thought to be the domain of gods.

rulesStrings.li: subject_story->spent a life proving that power obeys laws, and was disliked for it
subject_story->measured what everyone else was content to call a miracle
subject_story->wrote the first honest account of how Investiture actually behaves
